title: Figure 5: Schematic of the 1998 Dopfer momentum-entangled EPR experiment
description: Color optical schematic showing a 351.1 nm pump beam striking a LiIO3 crystal that emits two 702.2 nm photons: one through slits S1 and a lens to detector D1, the other through a lens with marked "2f" and "f" distances to a movable detector D2 (double-headed arrow). Both detectors connect to a "Coincidence" (&) unit. The caption reads "Figure 5. Schematic of the 1998 Dopfer Experiment (Reference 17)."
